text: Our Story | Ridgefield Academy Discover the story and heritage of Ridgefield Academy in Bloemfontein, offering international Cambridge and South African CAPS education since 2012. OUR STORY & HERITAGE Founded on Purpose, Growing in Excellence From a small beginning in 2012 to an established Cambridge International and national-curriculum school in Bloemfontein, explore the journey, ethos, and educational vision of Ridgefield Academy. Explore our pathways → Meet Ridgefield Start an Application 2012 Founded in Bloemfontein ZA338 Cambridge Centre EMIS 445802259 Dept of Education Max 15 Personalised Ratio LEARNING FROM THE HEART A school identity centred on learning and growth. The Ridgefield ethos connects academic rigour with personal character, fostering an environment where learners develop curiosity, integrity, and self-confidence. INTERNATIONAL CAMBRIDGE SCHOOL A school built around international learning and personal mentorship. According to Ridgefield Academy’s published history, the school was founded in 2012 in Bloemfontein to respond to demand for a world-class international education. It began with a small group of high-school learners and later expanded to larger premises. The school is described as a registered International Cambridge School and examination centre, with School number ZA338, and is also registered with the South African Department of Education under EMIS 445802259. Discover Cambridge Pathway → TIMELINE Milestones in Our Journey How Ridgefield evolved to meet the growing educational needs of Free State learners. 2012 Ridgefield’s published history places the founding of the school in Bloemfontein in 2012, answering parental demand for international secondary education. 2013–2018 The school expanded through successive premises as learner numbers and the need for larger scientific and recreational facilities grew. 2020 The National Curriculum was introduced alongside the Cambridge syllabus in response to parent demand for high-standard CAPS secondary pathways. 2023 The first learners were accepted into the primary-school programme, completing the continuous Grade 1–12 educational journey. LEARNING FROM THE HEART Education with purpose and character. The published school history connects the name Ridgefield with the relationship between nature and humanity and describes the motto Learning from the Heart as an emphasis on responsibility, relationships and personal development alongside academic achievement. This philosophy underpins every aspect of student life—from small, conversational seminar classrooms to practical science laboratory workshops and mutual respect across year groups. OUR STORY · CAMBRIDGE Our Cambridge pathway Ridgefield Academy offers a wide range of subjects for the Cambridge International Education Examinations. Tuition is offered from Grade 8 to Grade 12, with the IGCSE (International General Certificate of Secondary Education) external examination written at the end of Grade 10 and the AS (Advanced Subsidiary) Certificate at the end of Grade 12. Selected A Level courses are also offered. Grades 8–12 Grade 8: Core Level / Introduction to IGCSE Grade 9: IGCSE 1 Grade 10: IGCSE 2 + International Examination Grade 11: AS 1 Grade 12: AS 2 + International Examination Evaluation & examination Student evaluation is ongoing through regular tests and assignments. Formal test weeks are scheduled during the first and third terms, with full-scale examinations at the end of the second and fourth terms. A mock final examination is held in September for learners writing final Cambridge examinations in October/November. Subjects available Ridgefield's published Cambridge subject offering includes English (First Language), Afrikaans (Second Language), French (Second Language), Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography, Business Studies, Accounting, Computer Science and History, with IGCSE and/or AS availability depending on the subject. Hands-on tuition Classes are kept small, with no more than 15 students. Ridgefield places strong emphasis on individual attention and student participation and provides practical science tuition through its equipped laboratory, including practical training and guidance in Physics and Chemistry. Recognition The Cambridge syllabus is recognised by universities worldwide. University and faculty entry requirements vary, so learners are encouraged to check the exact Cambridge subject and level requirements for their intended university and faculty. Information Collected by the Public Website The public application and enquiry forms collect learner identification details needed to initiate an admissions review (such as learner full name, date of birth, and current school), parent or guardian contact details (full name, relationship, email address, and mobile phone number), programme pathway preferences (Cambridge, CAPS Secondary, or Primary), and details entered into admissions questionnaire or enquiry message fields. 2. Sensitive Learner Documents By design, the public online application form does not collect birth certificates, learner identity document scans, academic report cards, or proof-of-address files through public web uploads. Families prepare physical copies or verified documentation for in-person review during the admissions consultation. If Ridgefield requires digital copies, admissions staff provide dedicated secure channels. 3. Why Information Is Used Information submitted through the public website is processed strictly to respond to family enquiries, review prospective applicant eligibility, coordinate admissions consultations and campus tours, verify grade readiness, and support enrolment operations. 4. Access, Security & Safeguards Personal information is accessible solely to authorised administrative staff and academic leadership who require access for legitimate educational operations. In production, web transmissions are protected using standard TLS/HTTPS encryption protocols. 5. Data Retention & Disposal Personal records are retained only for the duration necessary to satisfy the admissions review process or as required by South African educational record-keeping guidelines. 6. Enquiries & Information Rights Parents and legal guardians maintain the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of their submitted personal information. For privacy or data queries, please contact our administrative office via the official contact page . Important: This website notice describes the current public-site architecture and should be reviewed against Ridgefield's formal legal and institutional privacy policies.
